Can you escape the maze before the Monster gets you? 👀

Monsters and Mazes is a FREE multiplayer horror game! 

One player is the Monster. Everyone else has to solve the maze and RUN! 🏃‍♂️💨

ㅤ

🔥 Why Players Love Monsters and Mazes

ㅤ

👹 Be the Monster: Hunt your friends as a T-Rex, an Animatronic, Backrooms Smiler, and more!

🏃 Escape Together: Team up, solve the maze, and find the way out!

🗺️ 9 Mazes, 9 Monsters: Jungles, schools, the Backrooms, corn fields, and more!

🆕 New Stuff Every Week: New secrets, new monsters, new skins!

🎨 Get YOUR Skin in the Game: Win our skin contests and see your design in the game!

ㅤ
